FIELDS.NAME: Golden Valley Beverage Distributors
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Golden Valley Beverage Distributors, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@gvbeverages.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Golden Valley Beverage Distributors specializes in the wholesale distribution of a diverse range of beverages, including beer, liquor, and wine. Our operations are anchored by a commitment to maintaining compliance with all federal, state, and local alcohol licensing regulations, ensuring that we operate legally and avoid the risk of fines or license revocation. We prioritize responsible selling practices, with robust age verification procedures and staff training designed to prevent underage sales and minimize liability exposure.

Our facilities are equipped to handle a high volume of inventory safely and securely, supported by a central station alarm system, which is essential for safeguarding our assets given our inventory levels. We meticulously track our stock and sales data to facilitate efficient operations, ensuring prompt fulfillment of customer orders, including direct-to-venue deliveries for events. 

In adherence to safety standards, we regularly assess our inventory management systems and maintain thorough operational controls. Our workforce consists of trained sales associates and delivery personnel dedicated to providing high-quality service while following established protocols for responsible beverage service and customer engagement. Overall, Golden Valley Beverage Distributors is committed to fostering a reputable business environment while delivering exceptional beverage solutions to our clients.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not exceed $500,000 in contents or inventory and confirms that it operates without a centralized alarm system. We ensure all liability is rated on Business Personal Property at 100% replacement cost value, and we consistently demonstrate compliance with all federal, state, and local alcohol licensing and regulatory requirements. Additionally, our staff undergoes age verification procedures and responsible beverage service training, reinforcing our commitment to responsible service practices.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Golden Valley Events LLC - a catering and events management company focused on corporate and private events in the Denver area.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred from equipment theft on 09/12/2022, attributed to a break-in that resulted in missing refrigeration units worth $8,000. Status: Resolved, recovery efforts in place through local law enforcement, awaiting insurance payout. Additional inventory loss of $2,000 due to spoilage linked to equipment failure on 01/15/2023. Status: Resolved with no further claims anticipated.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A, Grade I Safe with a UL Listed label.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and on-site security personnel during business hours.
